content_of_post_to_answer: What is a small, 5-minute daily habit that completely changed your life within six months?
answer: A five-minute habit is powerful not because of the time it takes, but because it changes the relationship you have with consistency. Many people underestimate small actions because they measure effort instead of identity. A daily journal entry, walk, or reflection becomes a vote for the kind of person you want to become. The hidden benefit is not the habit itself; it is proving to yourself that you can trust your own commitments.
